caption: The drawing consists of fifteen rectangular and square samples of textile or surface patterns arranged in a grid with three columns. The objects are mostly abstract or floral motifs. The left column contains four larger squares, each featuring a different dark, muted color background (shades of purple, brown, and black) with sparsely scattered simple motifs such as lilac and green organic shapes, white dots with green and pink leaves, round pale yellow forms, and yellow-orange leaves with white accents. The middle column includes three larger squares, one at the top right with a diagonal brown area featuring small white dots and yellow plant-like shapes, a central square with a cream background and purple botanical designs, and a bottom square with a dark brown background and an off-white stylized leaf with a yellow right edge. The rightmost column displays a vertical sequence of eight smaller rectangles. These rectangles feature a variety of repeated designs such as alternating bands with purple waves and red dots, purple squares with yellow plant shapes, teal birds or shapes on a blue grid, a pink diamond lattice pattern on brown, beige jagged motifs on purple, yellow and brown plant clusters on beige, and blue and gray birds or leaves on a dark background. The overall composition is organized and each pattern is distinctly separated by white space.
title: 14 Textiles from Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
